title: Tallinn Tastebuds — restaurants
description: The full contents of data/restaurants.json. One object per approved place. There are deliberately no score, rating or ranking fields: inclusion is the verdict.

id.description: Lowercase slug. Used in the ?spot= URL and as the photos/<id>/ folder name. Never change it once shared.

name.description: The name as printed on the door. Never translated.

address.description: Street address as Estonian post would write it.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Inside Tallinn this is roughly 59.3 to 59.5.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Inside Tallinn this is roughly 24.5 to 25.0.

price.description: Price band, 1 to 4. Rendered as one to four euro signs. This is a cost band, not a rating.

types.description: Type ids that must exist in data/taxonomy.json. Never free text.

blurb.description: Your write-up, per language. The only per-place field that is translated.

mustOrder.description: Dish names exactly as the menu prints them. Not translated.

reel.description: Full permalink to the video, Instagram or TikTok, or an empty string if there is not one yet. Never invent a shortcode or an id.

photos.description: Filenames inside photos/<id>/. Just the filename, no path.

website.description: Optional. An empty string and a missing key both mean there is no website.

visited.description: Month you last ate there, YYYY-MM.

closed.description: true greys the pin out and adds a closed note. Prefer this over deleting a place, so links shared earlier keep working.
